# Complete pooled and equal-topic-macro P10 comparisons

All values use identical v4-eligible D rows. Δ is P10 minus the stated baseline. Intervals are paired pointwise 95% intervals from the original 2,000 draws. Per-topic results are in `complete_comparisons.csv`.
